subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action update land after direct Codex contract verification, or should the Codex Action bump be separated from the routine action updates?
rationale: Most substitutions are routine immutable minor-version pins, but the Codex Action and credential-bearing actions cross security and automation boundaries that require explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Verify and land together
options.body: Inspect the sibling Codex permission/runtime contract, require all exact-head workflow checks to pass, and then land the grouped immutable-pin update.

options.title: Split the Codex update
options.body: Land the routine action pins separately and review the Codex Action revision with its permission and runtime contract in a dedicated PR.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Keep the PR open until an owner can review all credential-bearing upstream changes and resolve any remaining check failures.

recommendation.title: Verify and land together
recommendation.body: Inspect the sibling Codex permission/runtime contract, require all exact-head workflow checks to pass, and then land the grouped immutable-pin update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner most broadly to the affected release and repository automation surfaces.
